chargebackFiling.issuerCommentary:
This chargeback is being filed under Mastercard Reason Code 4871, 'Chip/PIN Transaction — Lost/Stolen/Not Received'. Our cardholder, Ms. Jane Doe, reported her Mastercard as lost/stolen on 2026-01-08 at 09:30 AM EST. Despite the card being reported compromised prior to the transaction, a Chip/PIN transaction occurred at 'Retail Store' on 2026-01-10.

Mastercard rules explicitly state that a chargeback is permitted for a Card-present EMV Chip transaction with Cardholder verification (e.g., PIN) when the card was reported as Lost/Stolen or Not Received to the Issuer or its agent *before* the transaction date. This transaction falls squarely within this exception to the standard EMV liability shift, as the card was reported stolen two days prior to the unauthorized use.
